steps_add-watermark_1Desc: Select the photo or graphic you want to watermark. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP. Your image is processed entirely in the browser — nothing is uploaded.
steps_add-watermark_2Desc: Enter watermark text or upload a logo image. Adjust position, size, rotation angle, opacity, and color. The live preview updates instantly so you can fine-tune placement.
steps_add-watermark_3Desc: Click Apply Watermark to stamp your mark onto the image. Download the watermarked result — perfect for copyright protection, branding, or marking draft previews.
